svg.title: macOS · Shape-mation · Find shapes · summary after a pass over a locked register (sheet) · 760×680
svg.desc: Mirrors App/Shapemation/FindShapesView.swift — summaryCard and its By project card (resultRow) after a pass over a LOCKED register (WP0b, register forward-compat: LetsLapseKit/Shapes/ShapeRegisterLock.swift / App/Shapemation/ShapeRegisterLock.swift — a shapes.json written by a newer LetsLapse, or unreadable, is read past and never written) — in the Mac's 560-wide Shape-mation sheet over the Create tab. Drawn 2026-09-20, mirrored from the Debug build on the wp0b-root scratch library (12 city projects; the register of 'Photo 19. 9. at 20:00' is the version-2 fixture wp0b/toonew.json, detectorVersion 4 / version 2) with LL_SHAPEMATION=find LL_SHAPES_SCOPE=all LL_SHAPES_RUN=1; capture find.locked.png + AX dump. The capture's window was not key (grey traffic lights, the prominent buttons grey) — drawn here in the key-window look (accent), which is what the app shows when it is in front. The step is pushed from the home sheet: nav title 'Find shapes' 13/700 with the Back circle; the plan card (Detector · Sensitivity · Size · Family, Projects scope, 'Find shapes in N projects' — shapemation.find.svg on iOS, no Mac mirror yet) has been replaced by the SUMMARY CARD (llCard radius 18, 527.5×198.5 at y 115.5, 16 pt padding, 10 pt spacing): 'Nothing analysed' 17/600 (with N analysed: 'N projects analysed in 1.2 s'); the mode line 12 secondary 'Use all · all/high/all' (engine title · search token: family/sensitivity/size — the Mac's stored Use all / High; a fresh simulator reads 'Standard · all/medium/all'); '0 with at least one shape' 14 pt; four family pills (Label count + circle · oval · square · rectangle, 13/500, 10 × 5 padding, capsule) — tertiary text on secondary-12 % when the count is 0, primary on accent-12 % otherwise; the LOCK LINE (new, WP0b) 12 secondary: '1 register left as it was: written by a newer LetsLapse, or unreadable.' (plural: 'N registers left as they were: …'; an 'N pictures could not be read.' line would precede it); Run again (borderedProminent accent, 83.5×24, disabled when nothing is selected) · Change options (bordered, 119×24), 13/500. BY PROJECT (llCard radius 18, 527.5×91.5, 12 under): 'By project' 13/600 secondary with '0 ms median' 11 mono secondary at the trailing edge; one resultRow per project — the title 12.5/500 (middle-truncated), the family counts 11 pt or, with no shapes, 'failed' in system orange (#FF9500, Color.orange — a plain 'none' in secondary when the pass simply found nothing), the milliseconds 11 mono secondary in a 64 pt trailing column, and the pass's own note 10.5 pt under it, orange when failed: 'Shapes written by a newer LetsLapse' (the unreadable case reads 'Shapes couldn't be read'). Console for the same run: 'shapes: Photo 19. 9. at 20:00 written by a newer LetsLapse (version 2) — left as it is'. The plan card's inventory line gains '· N locked' and the chosen-projects list shows the row states 'newer LetsLapse' / 'unreadable' for such a register (desc-only, not captured). Same screen on iOS: ../iOS/shapemation.find.done.portrait.svg (stale: drawn before the test-bench cards and WP0b; the 2026-09-20 iPhone 16 Pro capture find.locked.png shows the identical summary and row).
